dhp129:4:
ghātaye → prāṇā yathātamano’bhīṣṭā bhūtānāmpi te tathā 
ātemaෟpamyena bhūteṣū dayāṃ kurvanti sādhavaඃ (hitopadeśa. 1. 2)
dhp131:4:
sukhaṃ → ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni daṇḍena vitihanti yaඃ 
ātmanaඃ sukhamicchan sa pretya naiva sukhī bhavet. (mahābhārata 13.5565)
yo’hiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasatyātmasukhecchayā 
sa jīvaṃśava mṛtaśaicva na kvavit sukhamedhate. (manusmṛti. 5. 45)
dhp141:4:
avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ → na naganacaryyā na jaṭā na paṅko 
nānāśanaṃ sathaṇḍilaśāyikā vā 
na rajomalaṃ notkuṭukapradhānaṃ 
viśodhayenemāhaviśīrṇakāṃkṣam. (divyāvadāna)
dhp142:4:
bhikkhu → alagito ya vi care a dhamu 
datu śatu sañatu brammayari 
savisu bhutesu nihai dana 
so bramaṇo so samaṇo so bhikhu. (prā, dha. B. 39) 

alaṃkṛtaśvāpi carena dharmaṃ 
dāntendriyaඃ śāntaඃ saṃyato brahmacārī 
savēṣū bhūteṣu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ 
sa brāhmaṇaඃ sa śramaṇaඃ sa bhikṣuඃ. (divyāvadāna)
